item.title: Shabbat Shalom from Israel!
item.description:
Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' Israel desk is stopping its round-the-clock news updates at this time in honor of Shabbat. Jerusalem candle lighting time is 16:12 on Friday. Our North American desk will keep you informed until the 17:36 EDT candle lighting time in New York.
The updates from Israel will resume Saturday night, following the conclusion of Shabbat at 17:28 in Jerusalem.
Shabbat Shalom!

item.title: North Korean hackers behind Binance breach
item.description:
North Korean hackers were responsible for stealing approximately $6.3 billion in cryptocurrency from Binance, according to a report by US blockchain analytics firm TRM Labs.
According to the company, the attackers transferred approximately $6.36 billion from the exchange's wallets across ten blockchain networks, with most of the funds moved in just 20 minutes. TRM Labs attributed the attack to the North Korean hacking group TraderTraitor with a high degree of confidence.
